# CAO modernization review boundary

Changes must match the exact approved per-repository issue and plan revisions,
with satisfied dependency evidence and a CAO-admitted one-target worker.
Require an independent revision-bound quality verdict and independently
verified applicable acceptance outcomes. Preserve blocked/unavailable evidence;
never self-certify or treat planned tests as results.

Only a declared CAO safe output may publish the implementation as a **draft
pull request**. Squad does not commit, push, publish issues/PRs directly, mark
ready, approve, merge, or enable automatic merge. Humans retain merge authority.
Deployment, data movement, production cutover and rollback remain separate.
